jobs.title: Vibee - Business Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
Job Summary:
WHO ARE YOU?
Do you enjoy live events? Do you excel in fast paced, creative environments? Then you’re in luck! We are looking for a highly motivated self-starter who embodies both a passion for music and a love of the live event experience. Is this you? Read on…

WHO ARE WE?
Vibee builds unforgettable destination experiences for fans around the world. Founded by Live Nation, the world’s leading live entertainment company, and Insomniac, Vibee provides fans the opportunity to immerse themselves in the best music and entertainment events on land and sea. From curated activations to bespoke festival packages, Vibee creates transformative moments in the most sought after destinations.

THE ROLE
We are seeking a highly motivated and detail-oriented Business Operations Coordinator to support our Business Operations team. This role is integral to the efficient functioning of the company, focusing on the creation and management of BI tools and providing operational support across departments. You will work closely with various teams, providing insights through reporting tools created in Metabase and supporting operations with Microsoft Excel , Google Sheets , and project management applications. This position reports to the Senior Director, Business Operations, and is based in Las Vegas.

RESPONSIBILITIES
- BI Tool Development & Management:
- Consult with various departments to assess needs, identify opportunities, and implement solutions

- Create and manage customized reporting tools using Metabase .

- Continuously optimize and update BI tools to meet evolving business needs

- Business Operations Reporting & Audits:
- Create and maintain operational reports, audits, and checks using Metabase , Microsoft Excel , and Google Sheets and Google AppScripts .

- Support regular data analysis to ensure accuracy and efficiency in reporting

- Develop and streamline processes to enhance operational efficiency

- Project Management & Deadline Support:
- Assist with managing timelines and deadlines across various departments

- Use project management tools to track progress and ensure key milestones are met

- Coordinate with the Senior Director of Business Operations and SVP of Business Operations on priority tasks and deliverables

- Management and Maintenance of Internal Apps:
- Provide support via management and maintenance of several internally built apps

- Data and asset management

- Administration support and training

- Cross-Departmental Support:
- Provide support on ad hoc requests from other departments, helping them leverage data and reporting for better decision-making

- Facilitate communication and alignment across departments to streamline business operations

- Continuous Improvement:

- Gather feedback on communication performance and suggest improvements
- Stay informed about industry trends and best practices to enhance communication effectiveness
- Other duties as required

QUALIFICATIONS
- Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration , Operations Management , Data Analytics , or a related field.

- 1-3 years of experience in a business operations, data analysis, or similar role.

- Proficiency with Metabase , Microsoft Excel , Google Sheets, Google App Scripts, and SQL is essential.

- Experience with project management tools such as Asana or similar platforms is a plus.

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a focus on attention to detail.

- Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

- Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively with cross-functional teams.

- Demonstrated ability to manage multiple tasks and meet tight deadlines.

- Possess a strong work ethic with a high sense of responsibility in an ever-changing environment

- Must be able to handle sensitive matters and exercise excellent judgment

- Ability to work independently and within a team to juggle multiple prioritized tasks

WORK ENVIRONMENT
- Must be able to tolerate loud noise levels & busy environments on site at our events
- May sit for extended periods of time and work in drastic temperature climates onsite at our events
- Must be willing to work during evening and weekend hours, as required, to meet deadlines
- Must be willing to travel as required both domestically and abroad, if required
- Must have a current passport and be able to travel worldwide without restriction

Applicants for employment in the U.S. must possess work authorization, which does not require sponsorship by Vibee for a visa.

We aspire to build teams that reflect and support the fans and artists we serve. Every day we aim to promote environments where everyone can be themselves, contribute fully, and thrive within our company and at our events. As a growing business we will encourage you to develop your professional and personal aspirations, enjoy new experiences, and learn from the talented people you will be working with.

jobs.title: Director, Finance - Studio Operations
jobs.description:
Job Summary:
WHO ARE WE?
Live Nation Entertainment is the world’s leading live entertainment company, comprised of global market leaders: Ticketmaster, Live Nation Concerts, and Live Nation Media & Sponsorship. Ticketmaster is the global leader in event ticketing with over 620 million tickets sold annually and approximately 10,000 clients worldwide.  Live Nation Concerts is the largest provider of live entertainment in the world promoting more than 50,000 events annually for nearly 7,000 artists in 40+ countries. These businesses allow Live Nation Media & Sponsorship to create strategic music marketing programs that connect more than 1,200 sponsors with the 145 million fans that attend Live Nation Entertainment events each year. For additional information, visit  www.livenationentertainment.com .

WHO ARE YOU?
Passionate and motivated. Driven, with an entrepreneurial spirit. Resourceful, innovative, forward thinking and committed. At Live Nation Entertainment, our people embrace these qualities, so if this sounds like you then please read on!

THE ROLE
The Director of Finance will serve as the dedicated financial lead for Live Nation Studios, giving Studio leadership clear, timely visibility into project- and slate-level financial performance. This role will be embedded within the Studio organization and will partner closely with Corporate Finance and Accounting to ensure accurate reporting, forecasting, and financial controls.

The role will oversee production finance and accounting across the Studio's growing slate, including cost reporting, budgeting, forecasting, cash flow, and project close. The ideal candidate will also bring broader financial planning and modeling capabilities to help evaluate new productions, financing structures, partnerships, and business opportunities.

This role requires strong accounting and financial discipline, an understanding of physical production, and the ability to translate financial information into actionable insights for Studio leadership.

WHAT THIS ROLE WILL DO
Studio & Production Finance
- Serve as the primary finance partner to Live Nation Studios leadership.

- Provide timely visibility into Studio and project-level spending, forecasts, and financial performance.

- Oversee production accounting and financial reporting across the Studio slate.

- Monitor production budgets, cost reports, commitments, and cost-to-complete forecasts.

- Track budget vs. actual performance and identify potential financial risks or variances.

- Manage and forecast project cash flow.

- Oversee vendor payments, accruals, reconciliations, and project close in partnership with Corporate Accounting.

- Partner with production leadership on budgeting and financial planning throughout the production lifecycle

- Support tax incentive tracking and forecasting

Financial Planning & Analysis
- Develop Studio-level budgets and forecasts.

- Prepare regular financial reporting and analysis for Studio leadership.

- Develop dashboards and reporting tools to improve visibility across the Studio slate.

- Maintain accurate forecasting assumptions and identify key financial drivers

- Support longer-term financial planning as the Studio and its slate continue to grow.

Strategic Finance & Business Partnership
- Develop financial models to evaluate new productions and business opportunities.

- Support financial analysis of potential investments, partnerships, sponsorships, and other revenue opportunities.

- Perform scenario analysis to evaluate project economics, financing options, and cash flow requirements.

- Support greenlight and profitability analyses for new projects.

- Partner with Sales and other Studio teams to evaluate project economics and potential revenue scenarios.

Corporate Finance & Accounting Partnership
- Serve as the primary liaison between Live Nation Studios and Corporate Finance and Accounting.

- Partner with Corporate Accounting to ensure timely and accurate month-end reporting and project close.

- Ensure Studio financial processes align with corporate accounting policies and internal controls.

- Establish clear processes for sharing financial information between the Studio and Corporate teams

- Improve financial reporting processes so Studio leadership has timely access to accurate financial information.

Operational Excellence
- Develop scalable financial processes to support a growing slate of productions.

- Improve financial workflows, reporting, and forecasting processes.

- Identify opportunities to streamline or automate financial reporting

- Establish financial best practices across Studio projects.

WHAT THIS PERSON WILL RING
- Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, or related field.

- 10 - 12 years of experience in finance, accounting, production finance, or a related discipline.

- Experience supporting film, television, media, live entertainment, or other content businesses strongly preferred.

- Strong understanding of production accounting, budgets, cost reporting, forecasting, and cash flow.

- Strong financial modeling and analytical skills.

- Experience working within a larger corporate accounting or finance organization.

- Ability to communicate complex financial information clearly to both financial and non-financial stakeholders

- Experience partnering with production and executive leadership

Preferred
- CPA and/or MBA.

- Direct production accounting or production finance experience

- Experience with tax incentives and production financing

- Experience with financial planning and analysis

- Experience with ERP and financial reporting systems (Oracle preferred)

Success Measures
Within the first year, this role will:
- Establish clear and timely financial visibility across the Live Nation Studios slate.

- Enable Studio leadership to understand current spend, forecasts, and projected final costs without relying on ad hoc reporting from Corporate Accounting.

- Improve production cost reporting, forecasting, and cash flow management.

- Strengthen the partnership and flow of information between Live Nation Studios and Corporate Finance and Accounting.

- Develop consistent financial reporting and dashboards for Studio leadership.

- Build financial modeling capabilities to support greenlight decisions and new business opportunities

- Establish scalable financial processes that can support the continued growth of the Studio

BENEFITS & PERKS
Our motto is ‘Taking Care of Our Own’ through 6 pillars of benefits:
- HEALTH : Medical, vision, dental and mental health benefits for you and your family, with access to a health care concierge, and Flexible or Health Savings Accounts (FSA or HSA)

- YOURSELF : Free concert tickets, generous paid time off including paid holidays, sick time, and personal days

- WEALTH : 401(k) program with company match, stock reimbursement program

- FAMILY : New parent programs including caregiver leave, plus fertility, adoption, foster, or surrogacy support

- CAREER : Career and skill development programs with School of Live, tuition reimbursement, and student loan repayment

- OTHERS : Volunteer time off, crowdfunding match

EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY
We aspire to build teams that reflect and support the fans and artists we serve. Every day we aim to promote environments where everyone can be themselves, contribute fully, and thrive within our company and at our events. As a growing business we will encourage you to develop your professional and personal aspirations, enjoy new experiences, and learn from the talented people you will be working with.

jobs.title: VP, International IT Engagement and M&A Integrations
jobs.description:
Job Summary:
LIVE NATION ENTERTAINMENT
Global IT
VP, International IT Engagement and M&A Integrations

Department
Global IT
Division
International
Reports To
SVP / Global Head of IT Operations
Location
UK based (40% Travel Required)

About Live Nation Entertainment

Live Nation Entertainment is the world's leading live entertainment company, comprising Ticketmaster, Live Nation Concerts, and Live Nation Sponsorships & Advertising. Operating in more than 40 countries and producing over 35,000 events annually, we connect fans, artists, venues, and sponsors on a global scale. Our Global IT function is a critical enabler of this operation — delivering technology infrastructure, enterprise services, and innovation across every region we operate in.

Role Overview

The VP, International IT Engagement and M&A Integrations is a senior leadership role within Live Nation's Global IT department, serving as the primary operational and strategic interface for all International IT activity. This individual acts as the Business Point of Contact (BPOC) for regional business and IT escalations, IT service performance, and new business engagements (M&As), while providing direct support to the Global Head of IT Operations across strategic initiatives, budgeting, and resource management.

With a broad international remit spanning EMEA, APAC, Latin America, and beyond, this role requires a seasoned IT leader who can navigate complex, multi-regional environments, drive operational excellence, and lead with credibility at both an executive and local team level.

Key Responsibilities

IT Operations Leadership & Service Excellence
- Serve as the Business Point of Contact (BPOC) for all International business and IT escalations, ensuring issues are triaged, communicated, and resolved in alignment with global SLAs and business expectations.
- Provide hands-on oversight and strategic support to regional and local IT teams across international markets, ensuring consistent delivery of IT services.
- Help drive local Customer Satisfaction (CSAT) outcomes, implementing measurement frameworks, reviewing feedback, and leading continuous improvement initiatives.
- Act as the primary escalation point between regional business stakeholders and Global IT leadership, ensuring visibility and accountability across service tiers.

Support to Global Head of IT Operations
- Function as a key support and trusted advisor to the Global Head of IT Operations, contributing to organisational strategy, roadmap planning, and executive-level communications.
- Assist with the development and management of the IT budget, including resource planning, vendor management, capital expenditure approvals, and cost optimisation initiatives.
- Support headcount and resourcing decisions across the local portfolio, working with HR and regional leaders to ensure teams are appropriately structured and skilled.
- Contribute to the preparation of board-level and executive IT reporting across KPIs, service performance, project status, and risk.

Mergers, Acquisitions & New Business Integration
- Lead the IT workstream for global M&A integrations, acting as the primary IT interface for new acquisitions and business entities entering the Live Nation portfolio.
- Oversees the IT integration playbooks, ensuring newly acquired businesses are onboarded to Live Nation's global platforms, policies, and standards in a structured and timely manner.
- Act as the first point of contact for new business ventures across international markets, assessing IT readiness, identifying gaps, and defining integration roadmaps.
- Collaborate with Corporate Development, Finance, and Legal teams to ensure IT due diligence is completed effectively during M&A processes.

Compliance, Risk & Governance
- Serve as the main IT interface with Live Nation's Compliance function, ensuring IT operations adhere to applicable regulatory requirements, data protection legislation (including GDPR and regional equivalents), and internal governance standards.
- Work closely with the Group Data Protection Officer, Legal, and Risk teams to ensure IT policies and controls are operationally embedded across international regions.
- Oversee IT risk registers and remediation plans for international operations, escalating material risks to senior leadership as appropriate.

Global IT Leadership & Community
- Organise, chair, and drive the agenda for Global IT Leaders Conferences and international IT forums, fostering a cohesive global IT community and enabling knowledge sharing across regions.
- Build and maintain strong relationships with international IT leaders, ensuring alignment between local execution and global strategy.
- Champion Live Nation's global IT standards, tooling, and ways of working across international markets, balancing standardisation with appropriate regional flexibility.
- Represent International IT in global technology steering groups, business transformation programmes, and cross-functional initiatives.

Experience & Qualifications

Essential
- Significant senior IT leadership experience, with a demonstrable track record of managing IT operations across multiple international regions simultaneously.
- Prior experience at VP, Director, or equivalent level within a complex, multi-site, multi-country IT environment.
- Proven experience leading IT workstreams within M&A transactions, including pre-deal due diligence, integration planning, and post-merger execution.
- Strong background in IT service management (ITSM), including CSAT ownership, escalation management, and SLA governance.
- Experience as a business-facing technology leader, comfortable operating as a senior point of contact for non-technical business stakeholders.
- Sound commercial acumen with experience managing sizeable IT budgets across international operations.
- Deep understanding of IT compliance and regulatory requirements in international contexts, including data protection and cybersecurity frameworks.

Desirable
- Experience working within the live entertainment, hospitality, venues, or media/content industries.
- Familiarity with enterprise platforms and tooling deployed within Live Nation's environment (e.g., ServiceNow, Microsoft 365, Azure, SAP).
- ITIL, PMP, or equivalent professional certifications.
- MBA or equivalent business qualification.
- Experience working with or reporting into a Group CIO or CTO function within a large, publicly listed organisation.

Skills & Personal Attributes

- Exceptional stakeholder management and influencing skills — able to engage credibly from local IT engineers through to C-suite executives and Board-level audiences.
- Strong communicator with the ability to translate complex technical subjects into clear, business-relevant language.
- Highly organised and comfortable managing multiple priorities across time zones and cultures simultaneously.
- Collaborative leadership style with the ability to build high-performing, geographically dispersed teams.
- Commercially minded, with a focus on value delivery, cost discipline, and operational performance.
- Resilient and decisive under pressure, particularly during high-stakes escalations or rapid M&A integrations.
- Culturally aware and adaptable, with experience navigating diverse international business environments.
- Genuine passion for technology as an enabler of business growth and customer experience.

Travel & Working Arrangements

This role requires regular international travel to support regional teams, attend global leadership forums, lead M&A integration activity on the ground, and represent International IT at senior business forums. Flexibility to work across multiple time zones is essential. Live Nation operates a hybrid working model; the location of this role is flexible within international markets where Live Nation has a significant operational presence.

Live Nation Entertainment is an equal opportunities employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Live Nation Entertainment will never request payment or equipment purchases as part of the hiring process. Recruiters will only contact candidates from official Live Nation or affiliated brand email domains.

jobs.title: Sr. Finance Director, SD Concerts
jobs.description:
Job Summary:
WHO ARE WE?
SD Concerts is a leading live entertainment company producing concerts, festivals, and major events in the Dominican Republic, with a presence across the Caribbean and Latin America.

Behind every event is a fast-moving team coordinating people, production, venues, partners, and technology. Our systems must support both the daily business and the moments when thousands of people are counting on everything to work.

WHO ARE YOU?
Passionate and motivated. Driven, with an entrepreneurial spirit. Resourceful, innovative, forward thinking and committed. At Live Nation Entertainment, our people embrace these qualities, so if this sounds like you then please read on!

THE JOB
The Senior Finance Director will serve as the finance leader responsible for all financial reporting, accounting oversight, internal controls, and financial compliance activities for SD Concerts. This role partners closely with executive leadership and operational teams to ensure the accuracy, integrity, and timeliness of financial reporting while providing strategic insights that support business performance and growth.

WHAT THIS ROLE WILL DO
- Lead the monthly forecasting process, providing guidance to SD Concerts business leaders on event forecasts, phasing, and key planning assumptions.
- Lead efforts to optimize accounting systems, including ERP systems, tools, and workflows to increase efficiency and improve data quality and accessibility.
- Prepare and deliver internal dashboards and analysis for senior management.
- Own the annual budgeting process and long-range financial planning, partnering with business leaders to align financial plans with strategic objectives.
- Consolidate financial results, operational metrics, and P&L activity, delivering variance analysis and actionable insights to senior leadership across forecast, budget, and prior year performance.
- Build and maintain sophisticated financial models that support strategic planning, business cases, investment decisions, and resource allocation.
- Prepare executive reporting packages, dashboards, and ad hoc financial analyses to support operational and strategic decision-making.
- Support long-term strategic planning, financial forecasting, budgeting, and reporting processes while continuously improving forecast accuracy and financial visibility.
- Oversee cash flow planning and reporting, ensuring accurate and timely financial reporting and strong financial controls.
- Partner with senior leadership to strengthen the financial infrastructure, processes, and reporting capabilities required to support continued growth.
- Identify and implement process improvements, automation opportunities, and reporting enhancements that increase efficiency and improve financial decision-making.
- Leverage financial systems and reporting tools, including Oracle, Excel, BPC, Business Objects, and other analytics platforms to analyze large data sets and generate meaningful business insights.
- Lead, mentor, and develop finance team members through coaching, performance feedback, and professional development.

WHAT THIS PERSON WILL BRING
- Bachelor’s Degree or higher in Finance or related field
- 10+ years of relevant experience.
- Exceptional analytical problem solving and data modeling experience.  Experience in applying these skills to resolve operational performance problems is a plus.
- ERP experience, preferably Oracle, but equivalent is sufficient
- Ability to work flexible hours in support of the business.
- Detail oriented, with a desire to understand every aspect of the business.
- Ability to interact with senior executives and management.
- Ability to solve problems by gathering information, discussing options and making recommendations.
- Strong communication skills in both English and Spanish; written and verbal.
- Must be able to handle multiple priorities and effectively meet critical deadlines.

jobs.description:

Wearing its homegrown values on its sleeve, Brooklyn Bowl is committed to locally made products, environment sustainability, and boasts an unprecedented combination of top-flight music, bowling, beer, and food.

The Operations Manager is responsible for assisting the Director of Operations in overseeing all aspects of food, beverage and bowling. The role is responsible for achieving guest service standards, revenue and income objectives and assisting with enforcing policies and procedures.

RESPONSIBILITIES INCLUDE, BUT ARE NOT LIMITED TO:
- Review activities in all areas: the restaurant, bars, bowling lanes, service areas, etc. in order to gauge and improve staffing levels, working conditions and other matters which influence quality guest service and profitability.

- Monitor and evaluate performance of all food, beverage and bowling areas, in order to facilitate ongoing improvement of operations and financial return.
- Review schedules to ensure appropriate coverage based on projected business volume prior to being posted
- Review ongoing opportunities such as cost of sales, inventory par levels, and general policies and procedures in order to most effectively implement changes to improve operations and most efficiently allocate resources.
- Assist with pre-screening potential candidates, retain, motivate, evaluate and direct employees to ensure they receive adequate guidance and resources to accomplish established objectives.
- Ensure that all areas adhere to strict health code guidelines.

NON-PHYSICAL QUALIFICATIONS:
- Knowledge of food and beverage production and preparation techniques.
- Familiarity with effective food and beverage service techniques and sales strategies.
- Familiarity with the latest in food service and beverage service equipment.
- Knowledge of and previous experience with financial planning and analysis.
- Knowledge of and experience with operational planning and analysis.
- High school education is required, Bachelors’ degree in hotel and restaurant management or related field is preferred.
- Minimum of five years progressive managerial experience in the food and beverage industry required.
- Use all equipment associated with the position, including but not limited to computer keyboard.
- Review and comprehend all necessary documentation.
- Communicate effectively at all times, with guests as well as all levels of employees.
- Operate in a working environment that is subject to varying levels of crowds and noise; the severity of which depends upon customer volume.
- Observe and direct actions of employees.
- Hire, motivate and direct individuals with varying professional backgrounds.

We at Ticketmaster know exactly what fans want. jobs.description:
Job Summary:

JOB DESCRIPTION – HR Operations Analyst
Location: Philippines
Division: Human Resources – HR Shared Services
Line Manager: Associate Director, HR Operations
Contract Terms: Regular, Full-Time
Job Level – P2 – Professional

THE TEAM

The Ticketmaster HR team is a group of superstars that are at the core of all employee activities at Ticketmaster. We strive to standardize all of our processes, to create a meaningful employee experience for our teams and to champion a culture of problem-solving, collaboration and teamwork. Within HR, the HR operations team oversees all day-to-day administrative and transactional activities throughout the employee lifecycle, execute on organization-wide processes, problem-solve issues, and lead the strategy behind people data and analytics.

THE JOB

The HR Operations Analyst will provide global support for the Human Resources team and is responsible for the day-to-day activities to help support HR business partners and leaders across Ticketmaster. Reporting directly to the Associate Director HR Operations, the HR Operations Analyst will assist employees and managers on a variety of employee and/or contingent worker life-cycle processes and services. This position will act as a primary point of contact for HR-related requests. The role requires the ability and willingness to complete daily tactical responsibilities and work with a variety of organizational & people-related issues. This individual will focus on enforcing compliance and reducing liability risks while establishing effective communication between HR, the business, and service teams.

WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING

- HR Operations & Employee Lifecycle - Serve as a senior HR Operations subject matter expert, owning complex employee-lifecycle processes, advising HR and business leaders, and leading operational improvement, data-quality, and change initiatives.
- Act as a trusted point of contact for employees locally and globally, responding to questions about HR programs, policies, resources, systems, and procedures.
- Process employee lifecycle transactions accurately and efficiently through Workday , including new hires, employee changes, transfers, compensation-related changes, and exits.
- Partner with managers and HR leaders on complex employee changes, including leaves, promotions, transfers, immigration, terminations, and contingent-worker matters.
- Act as a consultant to HR and business leaders on HR Operations issues and status-change decisions, applying sound judgment within established policies and procedures.
- Plan and execute cyclical people programs, including performance reviews, promotions, talent reviews, and training.
- Draft employment contracts, job change letters, and other employee documentation for distribution.
- Ensure employee transactions and records are entered, processed, reviewed, and audited accurately and on time.
- Execute one-time payment transactions and provide accurate information to the appropriate teams for payroll processing.
- Handle employee and organizational information with appropriate discretion and confidentiality.

- Shared Services Transition & Process Improvement - Support the transition of HR operational activities from HR Business Partner teams into the central HR Shared Services organization, partnering closely with local HRBP teams and HR Operations leadership.
- Document current and future-state workflows and identify opportunities to simplify, standardize, and improve HR processes.
- Coordinate HR Operations workstreams for reorganizations, mergers and acquisitions, and other organization-wide change initiatives.
- Help develop scalable HR Operations practices that improve efficiency, consistency, and the employee experience.
- Create, maintain, and continuously improve process documentation, internal reference guides, HR systems documentation, and materials supporting background-check and other HR processes.
- Identify recurring operational issues and recommend practical solutions or process improvements.
- Coach junior HR Operations team members and serve as an escalation point for complex operational issues, as applicable.

- HR Systems, Data & Technology - Lead cross-functional HR technology and process-improvement initiatives from analysis and design through testing, implementation, adoption, and continuous improvement.
- Maintain high standards of HR data quality, accuracy, and integrity.
- Perform regular reviews and audits of employee transactions and HR data.
- Own a defined cadence of HR data-quality audits and operational metrics, ensuring timely follow-up and resolution of identified issues.
- Use HR systems and reporting tools to investigate issues, identify relevant factors, and determine appropriate actions within established policies and procedures.
- Partner with HR, Payroll, HRIS, and other stakeholders to resolve operational and system-related issues.

WHAT YOU NEED TO KNOW (or TECHNICAL SKILLS)

We recognize that strong candidates may bring different combinations of experiences and strengths. If you meet most of the qualifications below and believe you can make an impact in this role, we encourage you to apply.

- HR Operations & Employee Lifecycle Experience

- Approximately 3–5 years of experience in HR Operations, HR Shared Services, HR Administration, or a related HR operations role , ideally within a multinational or complex organization.
- Hands-on experience supporting end-to-end employee lifecycle processes , including onboarding, employee changes, transfers, compensation-related transactions, documentation, and offboarding.
- Experience processing and reviewing HR transactions while maintaining high standards of accuracy, timeliness, confidentiality, and data integrity .
- Experience working within a Shared Services or centralized HR Operations environment and collaborating with HR Business Partners and other HR teams is preferred.
- Ability to understand operational issues, analyze relevant information, and exercise sound judgment within established policies, processes, and procedures.

- HRIS, HR Technology & Data

- Hands-on experience using HRIS and HR technology platforms to manage employee data and HR transactions.
- Experience with Workday is strongly preferred , particularly for employee lifecycle transactions and employee data management.
- Strong understanding of HR data quality and data integrity , including transaction validation, reconciliation, and auditing.
- Ability to identify system or data issues, investigate root causes, and partner with relevant teams to resolve them.
- Experience contributing to HR technology enhancements, testing, process changes, and user feedback is preferred.
- Comfortable learning new HR technologies and working across multiple systems and digital platforms.

- AI, Automation & Digital Capability

- Practical experience using AI and generative AI tools to improve productivity, research, documentation, knowledge management, data analysis, or HR operational processes.
- Ability to identify opportunities to use AI, automation, and digital tools to simplify repetitive activities, reduce manual effort, improve service delivery, and enhance HR Operations efficiency.
- Demonstrated ability to use AI tools responsibly and thoughtfully , including validating AI-generated outputs and maintaining appropriate confidentiality, data privacy, security, and human oversight when working with employee or HR information.
- Ability to critically evaluate AI-generated information rather than relying on outputs without appropriate review and validation.
- Curiosity and willingness to explore emerging AI-enabled HR technologies, automation opportunities, and new ways of working .

- Process Documentation & Knowledge Management

- Experience creating, maintaining, and improving Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), process documents, workflows, internal reference guides, and knowledge-management content .
- Experience with Lucid chart / Lucid or similar tools for developing process maps, workflows, and operational documentation .
- Ability to translate complex HR processes into clear, practical, and user-friendly documentation .
- Experience documenting current-state and future-state processes and identifying opportunities for standardization, simplification, and continuous improvement .
- Strong attention to version control, document accuracy, governance, and maintenance of HR process documentation.

- Document & Workflow Management Tools

- Experience using Box or similar cloud-based document management and collaboration platforms.
- Experience with DocuSign or similar electronic signature and document workflow platforms, particularly for employment contracts, employee letters, and other HR documentation .
- Understanding of appropriate document access, confidentiality, retention, and data-security practices when handling employee information.
- Comfortable managing HR documentation across multiple digital tools while ensuring information remains accurate, organized, secure, and accessible to appropriate stakeholders.

- Microsoft Office & Data Analysis

- High proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including Excel, Word, mail merge, PowerPoint, and Outlook.
- Strong Microsoft Excel capability, including: - VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP or equivalent lookup functions
- PivotTables
- Data Validation
- Data reconciliation and comparison
- Data cleansing and quality checks
- Basic HR data analysis and reporting

- Ability to organize and interpret HR operational data to identify discrepancies, trends, or areas requiring follow-up.

- HR Compliance & Audit

- Working knowledge of applicable employment legislation, HR policies, statutory requirements, and HR compliance practices relevant to the populations supported.
- Familiarity with HR audits, employee data audits, compliance reviews, and documentation requirements .
- Ability to maintain appropriate records and supporting documentation to meet internal control and audit requirements.

YOU (BEHAVIOURAL SKILLS)

You are likely to succeed in this role if you:

- Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking skills , with the ability to analyze situations, identify relevant factors, exercise sound judgment, and determine appropriate actions.
- A continuous-improvement mindset , with the ability to identify opportunities to simplify, standardize, automate, and improve HR processes while balancing employee experience, operational efficiency, compliance, and data accuracy.
- Strong written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills , with the ability to explain HR policies, processes, systems, and solutions clearly, professionally, and respectfully to different audiences.
- Strong employee and customer-service orientation , with the ability to handle questions and sensitive situations with professionalism, discretion, empathy, and appropriate confidentiality.
- Strong stakeholder management and collaboration skills , including the ability to influence appropriately and adapt communication and working style across different levels, functions, cultures, and geographies.
- Comfortable partnering across teams during process transitions, system implementations or enhancements, organizational changes, and operational improvement initiatives .
- Strong time-management, organizational, and prioritization skills , with the ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining accuracy and meeting deadlines.
- Proven ability to succeed in a fast-paced, flexible, service-oriented, and evolving environment , including navigating ambiguity and changing priorities.
- Ability to work independently, take ownership, and drive issues through resolution , while exercising sound judgment about when to seek guidance or escalate

jobs.description:
Job Summary:
Company: Live Nation
Department: Business Intelligence
Location: Farringdon, London
Reports to: Business Intelligence Manager, Tableau
Working Hours: Full time (flexible working considered)
Job Type: Permanent

Role Description

This role would be perfect for someone looking to create reports and interactive Tableau dashboards in a business facing role, with a strong background in SQL or PostgreSQL.

You will be hands-on developing dashboards, but developers in our team are responsible for the full data pipeline. Building the queries, views and functions in SQL is often the most complex part of this process, so we want you to have those skills as well.

You’ll need to be confident building rapport with people from across the business as well as using your SQL and data visualisation skills to bring together the data they need to make faster, better decisions.

What it’s like to work in the Team

You will be part of Live Nation UK & Ireland’s Business Intelligence team. We are a business focussed team, and our mission is to help the business better understand itself.

We sit at the heart of Live Nation UK&I, working with teams across our concerts, festivals and venues business to deliver systems, solutions, reporting and insight.

We are a collaborative and diverse team of creative problem solvers, with plenty of autonomy and the freedom to explore new ideas. With the opportunity to shape new ways of working and deliver projects, we have a real impact across the business.

What we can offer you

Live Nation offers impressive employee benefits including tickets to shows and festivals and unlimited annual leave. The Farmiloe Building in Farringdon, London is a beautiful office to work in. Staff can enjoy use of arcade games in the basement games room, onsite gym equipment plus fitness and meditation classes. In addition to this, the office has a fully stocked complimentary coffee bar with barista to serve you your favourite coffee as you walk into the office and offers heavily subsidised lunch options. We hold regular staff events in our atrium stage space including hosting speakers and open mic nights to showcase Live Nation employee talent.

Who you are

Competencies / Skills / Knowledge / Experience

- Experience writing complex queries, views and functions from scratch in PostgreSQL or SQL in a fast-paced business environment
- Demonstrable understanding of relational databases and data pipelines
- Confident interpreting data and sharing it in a relatable way
- Strong understanding of what makes good visual design

jobs.description:
Job Summary:
WHO ARE WE?
SD Concerts is a leading live entertainment company producing concerts, festivals, and major events in the Dominican Republic, with a presence across the Caribbean and Latin America.
Behind every event is a fast-moving team coordinating people, production, venues, partners, and technology. Our systems must support both the daily business and the moments when thousands of people are counting on everything to work.

WHO ARE YOU?
Passionate and motivated. Driven, with an entrepreneurial spirit. Resourceful, innovative, forward thinking and committed. At Live Nation Entertainment, our people embrace these qualities, so if this sounds like you then please read on!

THE JOB
SD Concerts is seeking an experienced and highly motivated Human Resources Manager to lead the day-to-day Human Resources function for the company in Santo Domingo, Dominican Republic.
The Human Resources Manager will serve as a trusted partner to SD Concerts leadership and employees, with responsibility for the full employee lifecycle and the effective delivery of HR programs and practices across the organization. This role will oversee key areas including talent acquisition, onboarding, employee relations, performance management, compensation and benefits, learning and development, HR administration, labor compliance, organizational development, and employee engagement. This is a hands-on role requiring someone who can operate strategically while also managing the day-to-day HR needs of a growing live entertainment business.

WHAT THIS ROLE WILL DO
- Serve as the primary Human Resources partner to SD Concerts leadership and employees, providing practical, business-focused guidance and developing people strategies that support the company’s objectives, organizational needs, and continued growth.
- Manage the full employee lifecycle, including workforce planning, recruitment and selection, onboarding, performance management, employee development, compensation and benefits, engagement, retention, and offboarding, partnering with Live Nation resources as appropriate.
- Advise and coach managers on employee relations matters, including performance concerns, workplace issues, disciplinary actions, conflict resolution, and employee separations, partnering with Legal and other internal or external advisors when appropriate.
- Ensure HR policies, employment practices, documentation, and employee-related decisions comply with Dominican Republic labor laws and regulations, local social security requirements, and applicable company policies and standards, including required processes with the Tesorería de la Seguridad Social (TSS) and other relevant authorities.
- Manage employee data and HR processes in Workday, ensuring employee records, organizational structures, job information, and other employee transactions are accurate, complete, and processed in a timely manner.
- Lead performance and talent management activities, partnering with managers to establish clear expectations, provide meaningful feedback, identify development opportunities, and support the development and retention of high-performing talent.
- Support compensation and benefits programs, including compensation planning, salary and incentive recommendations, employee benefits administration, and other monetary and non-monetary rewards, considering internal equity, market practices, and the company’s financial objectives.
- Identify organizational and employee development needs and coordinate relevant training and development initiatives, including programs available through INFOTEP and other external providers.
- Develop and execute employee engagement, culture, and internal communication initiatives that foster a collaborative, inclusive, high-performing, and positive work environment and reinforce SD Concerts and Live Nation values.
- Maintain effective HR operations and controls, including accurate employee records and personnel files, job descriptions, organizational documentation, HR reporting, and the annual Human Resources budget; analyze relevant workforce metrics and trends to provide leadership with meaningful insights and recommendations.
- Partner closely with Live Nation’s Latin America and global Human Resources teams, as well as Finance, Legal, Payroll, and other functional partners, to implement applicable company programs, policies, processes, and best practices while addressing local business and regulatory requirements.
- Support workplace health, safety, and employee wellbeing initiatives and help ensure appropriate working conditions for employees.
- Provide HR support for concerts, festivals, and other live events as needed, recognizing the unique staffing, scheduling, and operational demands of the live entertainment industry.
- Manage and develop HR team members, where applicable, and foster a high level of service, accountability, and responsiveness to employees and business leaders.
- Partner with Legal and appropriate internal and external advisors on labor and employment matters, claims, disputes, and other employee-related legal issues.
- Perform other HR-related duties and strategic projects as needed to support SD Concerts and the broader Latin America organization.

WHAT THIS PERSON WILL BRING
- Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Industrial/Organizational Psychology, Business Administration, or a related field.
- Strong proficiency in English is required given the role’s regular interaction with Live Nation’s regional and global teams.
- 7+ years of progressive Human Resources experience, including experience operating as a broad HR generalist or HR business partner.
- Prior experience in an HR Manager or similar role with responsibility for multiple areas of the HR function.
- Strong working knowledge of Dominican Republic labor law, employment regulations, social security requirements, and local HR practices.
- Demonstrated experience with employee relations, performance management, talent acquisition, compensation and benefits, learning and development, and HR administration.
- Experience advising managers and senior leaders on sensitive and complex employee matters.
- Strong judgment and the ability to handle confidential and sensitive information with professionalism and discretion.
- Demonstrated ability to build trusted relationships with employees and leaders at all levels of an organization.
- Strong interpersonal skills, emotional intelligence, and ability to navigate difficult conversations and resolve workplace issues effectively.
- Excellent communication skills and the ability to convey information clearly, thoughtfully, and concisely.
- Strong organizational and project-management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
- Proactive, solutions-oriented mindset with the ability to work independently and make sound decisions in a fast-moving environment.
- Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy and high-quality work.
- Experience working within entertainment, live events, hospitality, media, or another fast-paced, service-oriented industry is preferred.
- Experience working within a multinational organization or joint venture environment is a plus.
- Proficiency with Microsoft Office and experience working with HR information systems and related HR technology.
- Flexibility to support business needs outside traditional working hours on occasion, including concerts and live events.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, B2B Growth Marketing - EMEA
jobs.description:
Job Summary:

Location : London, UK (Hybrid)
Division : Ticketmaster
Line Manager: VP, Global B2B Marketing
Contract Terms: Permanent, Full-Time

THE TEAM

Ticketmaster's Global B2B Marketing team serves as the voice of the client within our organization. Our mission is to drive growth by developing strategies, tools, and content that expand the prospect pipeline, generate qualified leads, and deepen client engagement—across EMEA and globally. As a close partner to our sales and regional teams, we bring the Ticketmaster story to life across B2B channels, sharpen our brand positioning in the market, and reinforce our reputation as the industry's leading ticketing provider.

THE JOB

As Senior Manager, B2B Growth Marketing — EMEA, you will build and scale Ticketmaster’s lead generation engine across more than 22 markets. This newly created role is focused on driving pipeline growth through a coordinated inbound and outbound strategy.

You will lead EMEA’s lead generation strategy, including campaign architecture and budget allocation, working with regional business leaders, global B2B marketing and local sales and marketing teams to prioritise and activate the strongest growth opportunities.

You will then scale what works — turning successful campaigns into repeatable programmes, tools and playbooks that local teams can run and optimise themselves. The goal is to build a connected, data-driven lead generation capability that drives sustainable pipeline growth across EMEA.

WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING

- Deliver against EMEA lead generation pipeline targets across inbound and outbound channels.
- Help shape and activate EMEA’s lead generation strategy in support of regional priorities, recommending where to invest, where to run lighter automation and how to sequence markets as the function scales.
- Partner with priority markets on local lead generation plans, translating regional priorities into programmes that reflect each market’s audience, sales motion and maturity.
- Build and launch lead generation campaigns with key markets using Apollo (outbound) and MCAE/Pardot (inbound), while managing and advising on paid media investment across LinkedIn, Meta and other B2B channels.
- Enable local marketing and sales teams to run and optimise campaigns independently through training, playbooks, templates and hands-on support.
- Turn successful programmes into scalable, repeatable campaigns — including pre-built sequences, reusable creative and simplified briefing — so more markets can activate faster.
- Partner with global B2B marketing, content, marketing operations and data teams to give local markets the support they need to activate effectively.
- Build and maintain an EMEA view of lead generation performance, giving teams visibility into lead volume, quality, conversion and revenue attribution.
- Partner with local Sales teams to define lead routing, qualification criteria and follow-up expectations, so captured demand is consistently worked.
- Improve Salesforce campaign tagging and data quality so lead generation performance and attribution can be measured reliably.
- Identify and test new channels, audiences and growth opportunities, including AI-enabled approaches that improve lead generation workflows and performance.
- Report lead generation performance into EMEA B2B planning, using results to recommend where we invest and focus next.

WHAT YOU NEED TO KNOW (or TECHNICAL SKILLS)

- Solid proven B2B lead generation, demand generation or growth marketing experience, with a strong track record of building pipeline in complex, multi-market environments
- Hands-on expertise with Apollo.io (or equivalent) and Salesforce Marketing Cloud Account Engagement (Pardot), with the ability to build campaigns and enable others to run them effectively
- Proven experience managing paid media campaigns and budgets across LinkedIn, Meta and other B2B channels
- Experience training and enabling teams, turning successful campaigns into repeatable programmes, tools and playbooks
- Experience working across multiple European or international markets, with an understanding of EMEA market dynamics and audience nuance
- Strong command of CRM, lead generation reporting and attribution, with Salesforce CRM experience preferred
- Strong stakeholder management skills, with experience influencing teams across markets and functions
- Ticketing, live entertainment or B2B SaaS experience is a plus

jobs.title: Ancillary Sales Manager - Xfinity Center
jobs.description:
Job Summary:
WHO ARE YOU?
Are you a dynamic and results-driven professional with a passion for maximizing revenue and enhancing the guest experience? Do you thrive in a fast-paced environment, love music, and enjoy spending time in our venues during the summer?
We’re looking for someone who is:
Sales-minded –  You understand how to bundle products and create upsell opportunities that drive revenue Analytical –  You enjoy digging into concert data and metrics to identify trends and opportunities Innovative & creative –  You think outside the box to develop new revenue streams while enhancing the fan experience Outgoing & personable –  You build strong relationships with guests and team members alike A strong leader –  You have experience leading a small team and understand staffing, budgeting, and operational best practices
If this sounds like you, we want to hear from you!
THE JOB
As the Ancillary Sales Manager at Xfinity Center in Mansfield MA, you will lead a team responsible for generating revenue through club and seat upgrades, premier parking, lawn chair rentals, fast lane access, future ticket sales, and other upsell opportunities on show days. Your mission is to drive sales while ensuring an exceptional guest experience. This is a part-time, seasonal role (approximately April–November) that is primarily events-based on evenings, weekends, and holidays, and will include in-office pre and post-event responsibilities.
WHAT YOU’LL DO
Maximize Revenue & Guest Satisfaction
Oversee the execution of all upsell programs and ensure seamless guest interactions
Continuously analyze data and guest feedback to adjust pricing strategies and sales tactics
Identify new revenue opportunities that enhance the fan experience
Participate in the venue’s sustainability initiatives, helping to educate guests and staff on eco-friendly efforts while devising programs to reinforce these efforts
Lead & Develop a High-Performing Team
Train and manage the Ancillary Sales team to be proactive, sales-focused, and guest-friendly
Foster a culture of innovation and experimentation with product sales
Provide ongoing coaching to optimize sales performance
Interview and hire a professional, sales-driven team of individual performers and team players
Operational Excellence
Collaborate with venue leadership to ensure proper staffing and efficient operations
Work closely with the box office team to troubleshoot any issues with inventory, pricing, or guest concerns
Maintain inventory of ancillary products (lawn chairs, merchandise, etc.) throughout the season
Secure and reconcile day-of-show ancillary sales
Participate in the team’s post-show sweeps to include lawn chair removal and recyclables collection
Lead back-end construction of sales inventories, pricing, and other ancillary initiatives
Other related duties as assigned by management
WHAT YOU’LL BRING
Required:
A sales-driven mindset with a passion for increasing revenue Strong data analysis skills to identify trends and optimize sales strategies Innovative thinking to develop and implement new revenue streams A love for live music and being in the heart of the action Excellent guest service and relationship-building skill Leadership experience, with the ability to motivate and manage a small team Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate with all levels of leadership The ability to stand and walk for long periods of time, outdoors, in all weather conditions Availability for all events and necessary pre- and post-event duties on non-event days Ability to lift up to 25 pounds with proper lifting techniques
Preferred:
Continued education, certification, or literacy business, or a related field is preferred Experience in event sales or in a live music setting

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this position. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the functions.
While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to sit or stand for prolonged periods of time, walk various distances on both paved and uneven terrain; use hands and fingers; reach with hands and arms; bend, twist, crouch, or kneel; and talk or hear. The employee may be needed to lift and/or move up to 25 pounds using proper lifting techniques. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision and color vision. While performing the duties of this job, the employee may regularly be exposed to wet and/or humid conditions, cold weather, wind, dust or dirt, and extreme heat. The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate to loud. Employees may be exposed to flashing or strobing lights while on site.

jobs.description:
Job Summary:
WHO ARE WE?
Live Nation Entertainment is the world’s leading live entertainment company, comprised of global market leaders: Ticketmaster, Live Nation Concerts, and Live Nation Media & Sponsorship. Ticketmaster is the global leader in event ticketing with over 620 million tickets sold annually and approximately 10,000 clients worldwide.  Live Nation Concerts is the largest provider of live entertainment in the world promoting more than 50,000 events annually for nearly 7,000 artists in 40+ countries. WHO ARE YOU?
Passionate and motivated. Driven, with an entrepreneurial spirit. Resourceful, innovative, forward thinking and committed. At Live Nation Entertainment, our people embrace these qualities, so if this sounds like you then please read on!

THE ROLE
The Category Manager, Technology on Live Nation's Global Procurement team is jointly responsible for strategically managing $250M+ in annual IT spend. This hands-on role leads procurement for stakeholders' highest-priority technology projects – reducing cost structurally and permanently where possible, while supporting stakeholders' broader strategic and operational objectives. The role also shares responsibility for strategic supplier management within the category.

WHAT THIS ROLE WILL DO
Stakeholders & Sourcing
- Jointly develops, with the category leader and key stakeholders, the overarching enterprise-wide procurement strategies for Live Nation's technology spend, primarily software/SaaS, telecom and networking, physical and cloud infrastructure, cybersecurity, AI/ML platforms, and IT professional services.

- In a non-mandated environment, leads multiple simultaneous direct negotiations and full-lifecycle competitive sourcing events (e.g., RFPs).

- Advises senior executives on negotiation strategy, supplier selection and qualification, and contracting approach; analyzes business, financial, and legal risk and develops practical mitigation options.

- Partners with IT, Legal, Compliance, Privacy, Risk Management, Finance, and Operations to bring deals to closure.

Suppliers

- Supports stakeholders’ efforts to manage and maintain ongoing supplier performance, contributing to development and negotiated implementation of solutions to service, quality, and commercial issues and disputes.

- Represents Global Procurement with account representatives at Live Nation's incumbent technology suppliers.

Team
- Performs additional duties as assigned, consistent with the nature and level of this role, as business needs evolve.

WHAT THIS PERSON WILL BRING
- 5-7  years of progressively responsible experience in sourcing/procurement, supply chain, or operations transformation; top-tier consulting experience preferred.

- Proven track record of generating financial and operational value from procurement projects, ideally in a non-mandated environment; advanced influencing and negotiation skills.

jobs.title: Portfolio Manager, GRC Risk Operations
jobs.description:
Job Summary:
WHO ARE WE?
Live Nation Entertainment is the world’s leading live entertainment company, comprised of global market leaders: Ticketmaster, Live Nation Concerts, and Live Nation Media & Sponsorship. Ticketmaster is the global leader in event ticketing with over 620 million tickets sold annually and approximately 10,000 clients worldwide.  Live Nation Concerts is the largest provider of live entertainment in the world promoting more than 50,000 events annually for nearly 7,000 artists in 40+ countries. These businesses allow Live Nation Media & Sponsorship to create strategic music marketing programs that connect more than 1,200 sponsors with the 145 million fans that attend Live Nation Entertainment events each year. For additional information, visit  www.livenationentertainment.com .

WHO ARE YOU?
Passionate and motivated. Driven, with an entrepreneurial spirit. Resourceful, innovative, forward thinking and committed. At Live Nation Entertainment, our people embrace these qualities, so if this sounds like you then please read on!

THE ROLE
The Portfolio Manager, GRC Risk Operations is a hands-on player-coach responsible for the end-to-end operational health and delivery of an assigned Risk Operations portfolio. This role combines direct risk assessment execution, first-line quality assurance, intake and workload management, business engagement, reporting, project delivery, and people leadership.

The Portfolio Manager will directly manage risk analysts and oversee AI agents that support portfolio execution, creating a blended human-and-AI delivery model. The Portfolio Manager remains actively involved in the work, including completing assessments, QAing analyst deliverables, managing stakeholder communications and escalations, and driving projects and operational improvements. The role is accountable for ensuring work is prioritized, completed with quality, communicated clearly, and continuously improved in alignment with program requirements and broader security, privacy, compliance, and business priorities.

WHAT THIS ROLE WILL DO
- Own day-to-day operational delivery and overall health of an assigned portfolio, including intake, prioritization, workload allocation, backlog, cycle time, service levels, remediation, escalations, and stakeholder responsiveness.

- Personally perform third-party risk assessments across the full assessment lifecycle, including standard, complex, Critical/High, expedited, fast-track, and escalated reviews as needed; review supplier documentation and evidence, identify risk, document findings, develop remediation requirements, support exceptions, and communicate assessment conclusions.
- Perform first-line QA of analyst-completed assessments for completeness, accuracy, evidence quality, consistency, risk judgment, and adherence to standards; provide actionable feedback and coaching, identify recurring quality trends, and escalate work requiring independent final approval in accordance with program governance.
- Manage, coach, and develop team of risk analysts, including work assignment, capacity planning, performance support, skill development, and guidance on complex assessments, remediation, exceptions, and stakeholder issues.
- Lead portfolio intake support by reviewing incoming requests, confirming completeness, assessing urgency and complexity, aligning work to analyst capacity and expertise, and resolving or escalating intake issues that create delays or duplicate effort.
- Serve as a primary operational point of contact for business leaders, internal stakeholders, and external suppliers; provide portfolio-level updates, manage escalations, clarify next steps and timelines, and translate requirements into clear business-facing communications.
- Develop, gather, validate, and communicate portfolio metrics, dashboards, and status reporting, using data to monitor SLA achievement, backlog health, cycle time, workload, remediation, quality trends, stakeholder experience, and emerging portfolio risks; provide clear portfolio-health updates and recommended actions to leadership and business stakeholders.
- Lead or support projects and workstreams by defining scope, timelines, deliverables, owners, dependencies, risks, action items, and status; maintain project plans and schedules, coordinate cross-functional execution, translate operational needs into actionable requirements, and drive adoption of new processes, tools, controls, and program initiatives.
- Manage AI agents used to support portfolio operations by identifying appropriate use cases, directing and monitoring AI-enabled work, reviewing output quality, defining human-review and escalation requirements, and measuring operational value. Partner with the Technical Administrator and governance resources on agent configuration, integrations, controls, and technical enhancements while retaining accountability for how agents are used within the portfolio.
- Drive continuous improvement across assessment workflows, intake, reporting, communications, quality, and automation by identifying recurring friction, rework, capacity constraints, stakeholder pain points, and control gaps and translating those findings into practical operational improvements that improve portfolio health and scalability.

WHAT THIS PERSON WILL BRING
- 8+ years of experience in third-party risk management, information security, compliance, operational risk, audit, vendor risk, or a related risk discipline.
- 3+ years of experience in portfolio management, program/project management, business engagement, or operational leadership, with demonstrated ability to manage multiple workstreams and competing priorities.
- 2+ years of people leadership or direct management experience, including coaching, workload management, performance support, and development of analysts or comparable risk professionals.
- Hands-on experience conducting third-party risk assessments and evaluating supplier evidence, control environments, findings, remediation plans, exceptions, and ongoing due diligence.
- Experience reviewing or QAing risk assessment work and providing clear, consistent feedback that improves quality and analyst capability.
- Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, including the ability to translate risk concepts for technical and non-technical audiences and provide clear portfolio-level reporting and escalation updates.
- Strong project management skills, including experience managing scope, schedules, dependencies, risks, action items, and cross-functional delivery; experience with tools such as Asana, Jira, Smartsheet, or similar is preferred.
- Experience using metrics, dashboards, reporting platforms, workflow automation, or AI-enabled tools to improve operational visibility, efficiency, and scalability; experience overseeing AI-supported workflows or agent-based automation is preferred.
- Working knowledge of common security, privacy, and compliance frameworks and requirements such as NIST, ISO 27001, PCI, SOX, and GDPR.
- Ability to exercise sound judgment in a fast-paced global environment, balance hands-on execution with leadership responsibilities, and manage sensitive or confidential information with discretion.
- Relevant certifications such as CTPRP/CTPRA, CRISC, CISA, CISM and PMP, CAPM, Certified ScrumMaster, or comparable risk/project management credentials are preferred.

If the above description sounds like you and fits your background, apply online at  http://www.livenation.com/careers/index.html  to join the Live Nation Entertainment team today!

Passionate and motivated. Driven, with an entrepreneurial spirit. Resourceful, innovative, forward thinking and committed. At Live Nation Entertainment, our people embrace these qualities, so if this sounds like you then please read on!

THE JOB
The Financial Analyst supports financial planning, forecasting, reporting, and operational analysis across C3 Presents' festivals, events, and business operations. This role partners with Finance, Accounting, Sponsorship, Legal, Operations, and other business teams to provide accurate financial reporting, insightful analysis, and decision support.
The Financial Analyst is responsible for maintaining financial models, preparing forecasts and reports, analyzing business performance, and supporting budgeting processes. This position plays an important role in ensuring the accuracy of financial information while identifying trends, risks, and opportunities that support sound business decisions.

WHAT THIS ROLE WILL DO
Financial Planning & Analysis
- Assist with the preparation of monthly forecasts, annual operating budgets, long-range planning, and Capital Expenditure Requests (CERs).
- Prepare financial reports and analyze variances between actual results, forecasts, budgets, and prior periods.
- Maintain financial models, forecasting schedules, dashboards, and management reporting.
- Monitor forecast accuracy and recommend improvements to planning assumptions.
- Analyze revenue and expense activity to identify trends and investigate reporting discrepancies.
- Maintain financial tracking schedules and supporting business reports.

Process Improvement
- Identify opportunities to improve financial reporting processes, forecasting accuracy, and operational efficiency.
- Support implementation of reporting enhancements and process improvements.
- Assist with audit requests, reporting requirements, and financial documentation.

Reporting & Analysis
- Prepare recurring and ad hoc financial analyses for management.
- Develop reporting packages and dashboards that support departmental decision-making.
- Support additional finance projects and responsibilities as assigned.

- Perform additional duties and projects as assigned

WHAT THIS PERSON WILL BRING
- Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration, or related field.
- 3–5 years of experience in Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A), financial analysis, business analytics, or corporate finance.
- Strong analytical, quantitative, and problem-solving skills.
- Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including financial modeling and data analysis.
- Experience with Oracle, SAP, Hyperion, Adaptive Planning, or similar ERP and forecasting systems preferred.
- Excellent organizational, communication, and interpersonal skills.
- Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
- Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.

jobs.title: Brooklyn Bowl Las Vegas - Operations Supervisor
jobs.description:
Job Summary:
Operations Supervisor

Job Summary
Brooklyn Bowl, located in the LINQ Promenade in the heart of the fabulous Las Vegas Strip, has redefined the destination entertainment experience. Following in the footsteps of our original Brooklyn location, noted as “one of the most incredible places on Earth,” by Rolling Stone, we’ve stacked the deck for a truly unforgettable experience.

With three levels spanning nearly 80,000 square feet, it’s one of the largest music venues in America. Brooklyn Bowl integrates a premier performance venue, food by Blue Ribbon, bars which feature local craft brewed beers, and 32 bowling lanes which give guests a unique place to relax, eat, drink and watch a performance.

This position is responsible for assisting the Director of Operations and Operation Managers in overseeing all aspects of food, beverage and bowling. The incumbent will be responsible for achieving guest service standards to ensure the profitable operation of Brooklyn Bowl Las Vegas.

RESPONSIBILITIES INCLUDE, BUT ARE NOT LIMITED TO:
- Review activities in all areas: the restaurant, bars, bowling lanes, service areas, etc. in order to gauge and improve staffing levels, working conditions and other matters which influence quality guest service and profitability.
- Monitors and evaluates performance of all food, beverage and bowling areas, in order to facilitate ongoing improvement of operations and financial return.
- Review ongoing opportunities such as cost of sales, inventory par levels, and general policies and procedures in order to most effectively implement changes to improve operations and most efficiently allocate resources.
- Assist with pre-screening potential candidates, retain, motivate, evaluate and direct employees to ensure they receive adequate guidance and resources to accomplish established objectives.
- Ensure that all areas adhere to strict health code guidelines to maintain “A” status.

NON-PHYSICAL QUALIFICATIONS:
- Knowledge of food and beverage production and preparation techniques.
- Familiarity with effective food and beverage service techniques and sales strategies.
- Familiarity with the latest in food service and beverage service equipment.
- Use all equipment associated with the position, including but not limited to computer keyboard.
- Review and comprehend all necessary documentation.
- Communicate effectively at all times, with guests as well as all levels of employees.
- Operate in a working environment that is subject to varying levels of crowds and noise; the severity of which depends upon customer volume.
- Observe and direct actions of employees.
- Must be able to work a flexible schedule, including weekends and holidays.
- Understanding you may be scheduled to work on peak business days to assist with the running of buyouts, concerts and events.

THE PHYSICAL QUALIFICATIONS LISTED BELOW ARE GENERAL REQUIREMENTS FOR THIS POSITION. THE ACTUAL EXERTION LEVEL (AND FREQUENCY OF USE) CAN AND DOES FLUCTUATE DEPENDING ON THE INDIVIDUAL TASKS BEING PERFORMED.
PHYSICAL QUALIFICATIONS:
- Ability to move throughout the venue during the entire shift.
- Must have the endurance and ability to walk between 3 - 5 miles per shift to ensure adequate observation of assigned area.
- Must be able to lift and carry up to 35 lbs.
- Must be able to verbally communicate.
- Visual abilities needed for detailed paperwork and observation.
- Ability to bend, twist, stoop, climb and stand to perform normal job functions.
- Must be able to work in an environment with loud music and crowds for extended periods of time.
- Must be able to stand for entire shift.

REGULATORY AND COMPLIANCE RESPONSIBILITIES:
In addition to the other duties described herein, each and every employee has the following responsibilities related to compliance with laws and regulations:
- Perform the duties described in compliance with local laws and regulations.
- Take the necessary steps to ensure minors are not allowed to loiter in areas restricted to 21 years old and are not served alcoholic beverages.
- Have knowledge of the ordinances, regulations, laws, policies, and procedures relating to the standard operation of food and beverage operations in Las Vegas, NV.
- Takes the appropriate steps to investigate exceptions, fraud, and potential violations and report such instances to the appropriate levels of management.
- Reports any acts of wrongdoing on behalf of any staff member that they have knowledge of.
