jobs.description:
Job Summary:
JOB DESCRIPTION – Marketing Associate
Location: Athens, Greece
Division: Ticketmaster Hellas
Line Manager: Operations and Marketing Director
Contract Terms: Permanent, Full-time

THE TEAM

The Marketing team at Ticketmaster Hellas is responsible for building the Ticketmaster brand, engaging fans and supporting the commercial success of our clients’ events. Working closely with teams across Sales, Client Services, Customer Support and Operations, the team delivers integrated campaigns that connect audiences with the live experiences they love. As part of a collaborative, fast-paced team, you will contribute to marketing activity across digital channels, CRM, content, partnerships and event support. You will gain exposure to the full campaign lifecycle while helping to ensure every customer touchpoint reflects the Ticketmaster brand.

THE JOB

The Marketing Coordinator supports the marketing function of Ticketmaster Hellas, assisting in the planning, execution and coordination of marketing actions that strengthen the Ticketmaster brand, support commercial objectives and enhance customer engagement. Reporting to the Operations and Marketing Director, this role works closely with the wider Marketing team as well as Sales, Client Services, Customer Support and Operations, taking ownership of day-to-day marketing actions and ensuring campaigns and initiatives are delivered accurately, on time and in line with brand guidelines. This is an excellent opportunity for a motivated, detail-oriented individual at the early stages of their marketing career to grow within a dynamic, fast-paced environment at the heart of the live events industry.

WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING

- Take ownership of day-to-day marketing actions, ensuring campaigns, content and communications are executed accurately and on schedule.
- Support the planning and execution of integrated marketing campaigns across channels such as email marketing, social media, website and digital advertising.
- Coordinate the creation and scheduling of marketing content (copy, images, video) in collaboration with design and content resources.
- Assist in the management of CRM and email marketing activities, including audience segmentation, campaign set-up and performance tracking.
- Monitor and report on the performance of marketing campaigns, compiling data and insights to support decision-making.
- Liaise with internal departments (Sales, Client Services, Operations, Customer Support) to align marketing actions with commercial priorities and event needs.
- Support the coordination of marketing partnerships, promotions and event-related marketing activities.
- Manage on -site logistics, promotional materials and venue setups for company events.
- Help maintain brand consistency across all customer touchpoints, materials and communications.
- Assist with the administrative and operational aspects of marketing projects, including budget tracking, supplier coordination and timeline management.
- Conduct market research and monitor competitor and industry activity to support the wider marketing team with insights and recommendations.
- Increase brand awareness by shaping company identity and building public recognition.

WHAT YOU NEED TO KNOW (or TECHNICAL SKILLS)

- Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Business or a related field.
- Professional experience in marketing (0–2 years); internships are welcome.
- Prior experience in a ticketing, entertainment or events-related company is considered a strong plus.
- Genuine interest and eagerness to build a career in the events and entertainment industry.
- Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple actions and deadlines simultaneously.
- Good working knowledge of digital marketing tools (e.g. email marketing platforms, social media management tools, basic analytics).
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills in Greek and English.
- A proactive, collaborative attitude and willingness to learn.
- Attention to detail and a data-driven mindset.

KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS
Performance will be measured against agreed objectives, including areas such as:
- Timely and accurate execution of marketing actions and campaigns
- Quality and consistency of marketing content and communications
- CRM and email marketing campaign performance
- Support to cross-functional marketing initiatives
- Contribution to brand consistency across touchpoints
- Personal development and growth within the marketing function

LIFE AT TICKETMASTER

We are proud to be a part of Live Nation Entertainment, the world’s largest live entertainment company.

Our vision at Ticketmaster is to connect people around the world to the live events they love. As the world’s largest ticket marketplace and the leading global provider of enterprise tools and services for the live entertainment business, we are uniquely positioned to successfully deliver on that vision.

We do it all with an intense passion for Live and an inspiring and diverse culture driven by accessible leaders, attentive managers, and enthusiastic teams. If you’re passionate about live entertainment like we are, and you want to work at a company dedicated to helping millions of fans experience it, we want to hear from you.

Our work is guided by our values:

Reliability - We understand that fans and clients rely on us to power their live event experiences, and we rely on each other to make it happen.

Teamwork - We believe individual achievement pales in comparison to the level of success that can be achieved by a team

Integrity - We are committed to the highest moral and ethical standards on behalf of the countless partners and stakeholders we represent

Belonging - We are committed to building a culture in which all people can be their authentic selves, have an equal voice and opportunities to thrive

We are passionate and committed to our people and go beyond the rhetoric of diversity and inclusion. You will be working in an inclusive environment and be encouraged to bring your whole self to work. We will do all that we can to help you successfully balance your work and homelife. As a growing business we will encourage you to develop your professional and personal aspirations, enjoy new experiences, and learn from the talented people you will be working with. VIP Nation is Live Nation's premium fan experience business, designing and delivering VIP packages, meet-and-greets, hospitality, and exclusive merchandise for artists and tours worldwide. Reporting to the SVP, VIP Nation, the Sr Director, Operations is the senior operating leader of the division and second-in-command to the SVP, accountable for how the business runs: its processes, its infrastructure, its supply chain, and its people.

This is a build role. VIP Nation has grown on the strength of exceptional show execution, and its next phase of growth requires a professional operating foundation underneath it. The Sr Director, Operations will take a clear-eyed inventory of the current state of the business, then design and implement the systems, standards, and organizational structure needed to replace manual, individually held workflows with repeatable processes that scale.

The SVP, VIP Nation leads the business, owns its vision and commercial direction, and is the division's primary voice with artists, management, and internal leadership. This role carries a high degree of delegated authority over how the business operates day to day, and making that balance work requires exceptional partnership and communication: operating decisively while keeping the SVP fully apprised, aligning ahead of consequential decisions, surfacing issues early rather than after the fact, and ensuring the SVP is never surprised by something happening inside her business.

Success is measured by operational reliability, margin improvement, the quality and consistency of the fan and artist experience, and the strength, clarity, and retention of the team.

WHAT THIS ROLE WILL DO

Operational Efficiency
- Own the day-to-day operating cadence of VIP Nation — planning calendars, reporting rhythms, decision rights, and escalation paths — and establish and monitor, with the SVP, the key performance indicators covering operational efficiency, fulfillment accuracy, cost, fan satisfaction, and organizational health.
- Maintain a disciplined communication rhythm with the SVP, including regular operating reviews, clear escalation of risks and issues, and visibility into the decisions being made across the department.
- Conduct a structured assessment of the current state of the business — what exists, what is working, what is duplicative, and what is at risk — and present a prioritized roadmap to the SVP and executive leadership.
- Own the supply chain and logistics strategy for VIP programs — sourcing, production, inventory, freight, warehousing, and delivery to venue — setting the direction and standards, strengthening vendor agreements and service-level expectations, while leading and coordinating the existing team and partners who execute it.
- Institute service-level standards and quality controls across every VIP program so on-site execution matches what was sold to the fan, the artist, and the tour, and build a post-show and post-tour review process that converts lessons learned into documented standards.
- Document the standard operating procedures, templates, and process maps required for the business to be audited, handed off, and replicated as it grows.

Leadership
- Lead the functional teams responsible for program operations, fulfillment, logistics, vendor management, and business systems in coordination with the SVP.
- Establish clear roles, workload planning, and accountability across the department, and build manager capability so the business is not dependent on a small number of individuals.
- Assess talent across the division, identify capability gaps, and lead recruitment, development, and succession planning to build a durable leadership bench.
- Partner with Human Resources, Legal, Finance, and Risk to ensure the division operates cleanly within Live Nation policy and controls, including contracting, approvals, travel, and safety.

Technology
- Lead the modernization of the division's infrastructure, replacing manual, spreadsheet-dependent processes with integrated systems for order management, inventory, fulfillment, CRM, and reporting.
- Create a single source of truth for VIP Nation data and reporting that gives leadership real-time visibility into sales, fulfillment accuracy, cost, and fan satisfaction — built to work with the platforms, data infrastructure, and tools already in place at Live Nation rather than standing up parallel systems alongside them.

WHAT THIS PERSON WILL BRING
- 8+ years of progressive operations leadership, including experience as a head of operations or senior second-in-command of a multi-market business.
- Background in live entertainment, touring, premium hospitality, experiential marketing, e-commerce, or consumer products — any environment combining live deadlines with physical fulfillment.
- Demonstrated record of taking a fast-growing business from ad hoc execution to a scaled, process-driven operating model.
- Deep supply chain and logistics expertise — sourcing, production, inventory, freight, warehousing, and fulfillment at scale — together with proven vendor and contract management, including negotiating master agreements, consolidating spend, and holding third parties to measurable service levels.
- Experience selecting and implementing business systems (ERP, order management, inventory, CRM, or comparable platforms), with a clear understanding that the hard part is changing how people work, not buying the software.
- Strong financial acumen, including P&L exposure, budgeting, unit economics, and margin optimization, and the ability to partner effectively with finance leadership.
- Exceptional partnership skills, able to take ownership of an operation, drive change quickly, and keep the business leader and established team closely aligned throughout.
- Credibility with both commercial and creative stakeholders — able to hold an operational line with artists, management, promoters, and internal leadership without slowing the business down.
- Highly analytical and data-fluent, with advanced Excel and command of reporting and business intelligence tools, and the ability to build a business case for investment.
- Sound judgment, a collaborative leadership style, and the ability to drive timely, effective execution in a high-volume, deadline-critical live events environment; availability to travel, including show-site and peak-season travel.
- Bachelor's degree required; MBA or equivalent senior operating experience a plus.

BENEFITS & PERKS
Our motto is ‘Taking Care of Our Own’ through 6 pillars of benefits:

HEALTH : Medical, vision, dental and mental health benefits for you and your family, with access to a health care concierge, and Flexible or Health Savings Accounts (FSA or HSA)
YOURSELF : Free concert tickets, generous paid time off including paid holidays, sick time, and personal days

jobs.title: Group Finance Director APAC
jobs.description:
Job Summary:
About Live Nation:
Join the team at Live Nation, where innovation meets live entertainment on a global scale! With 40,000 shows and 500 million tickets sold each year, we’re the industry leader, powered by 44,000 talented individuals worldwide. At Live Nation, we’re passionate about transforming live events and creating extraordinary moments for artists, event professionals, and fans.

About the role:
If you’ve built a strong finance career and are ready to bring it to the world of live entertainment, this one’s for you. Join Live Nation’s APAC Reporting team as our Group Finance Director .

Sitting within the Finance team and reporting to the VP, Group Reporting and Controlling, APAC, you’ll be integrated into the financial planning and analysis function from day one. You’ll deliver accurate budgeting, forecasting and reporting, support financial accounting across the region and take on ad hoc projects as they arise. It’s a head office finance role with plenty of variety, and regular contact with colleagues across the globe.

Ready to make the move? Apply now with your resume and a cover letter telling us why you’re the right person for the role.

What you’ll be doing:
- Month end reporting: Analyse market submissions, dig into forecast versus actual variances and prepare consolidated templates for US Corporate.
- Data and metrics: Keep a close eye on key metrics including show count, attendance, show profitability and headcount to make sure everything stacks up.
- Controls and CAPEX: Strengthen key controls across APAC markets and track CAPEX actuals against forecast, policy and budget.
- Tour tracking: Build and maintain the financial tracking file for Western, KPOP and Asian tours across the region.
- Quarterly reporting: Prepare and present quarterly walk analyses and the Concerts Division Quarterly Business Review for US Corporate.
- Forecast and budget: Review monthly market forecasts, prepare the forecast pack and develop annual budget materials and presentations.
- Team and market support: Guide junior team members and support local finance heads on everything from accounting advice to financial systems.
- Acquisitions and compliance: Handle acquisition accounting journals, opening balance sheet reviews and divisional SOX reporting to internal audit.

What you’ll bring:
- Qualifications:  CA or CPA qualified.
- Relevant experience:  Strong accounting and reporting background, ideally in a large corporate, multinational or Big 4 audit environment.
- Excel and data skills:  Excellent Excel and data management capability.
- Clear communication:  Confident verbal and written communicator who can work with colleagues around the world.
- Self-starter:  Motivated and diligent, comfortable working with minimal supervision and managing your own time.
- Flexible approach:  Pragmatic and adaptable, with a hardworking attitude.
- Systems exposure:  BPC or Oracle exposure preferred, but not essential.
- US GAAP:  Exposure to US GAAP is desirable, but not essential.

The Benefits:
- A vibrant, music-focused workplace fostering creativity and collaboration.
- Opportunities for professional development and career advancement.
- A flexible approach to when and where you work, designed to support balance in all aspects of life.
- Access to concerts, events, and other entertainment perks.
- A diverse, equitable workplace where every voice matters.
- Comprehensive benefits, from volunteer days to wellness programs and mental health support.

Equal Opportunities:
We are passionate and committed to our people and go beyond the rhetoric of diversity and inclusion. You will be working in an inclusive environment and be encouraged to bring your whole self to work. We will do all that we can to help you successfully balance your work and Homelife. FIELD OPERATIONS MANAGER
Location: Austin, TX

THE TEAM

Front Gate Tickets is North America’s leading software and operations provider for the festival market. We provide technical solutions for e-commerce ticketing, access control, data management, and fan engagement. We partner and run on-site operations for over 200 festivals each year and are on a massive growth trajectory matched by no one in the industry. We do it for the fans!  Front Gate is owned by Live Nation Entertainment and acts as Ticketmaster’s festival arm. We have two offices located in Austin, TX. The position will be working out of those offices.

THE JOB

The Field Operations Manager is responsible for coordinating and overseeing the execution of onsite client events and festivals operations in collaboration with multiple departments and clients.

WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING

- Establish time-lines and equipment needs for installations and other on-site deliverables in collaboration with Client Operations Managers and clients.

- Create, fulfill and ship packing lists for all venues, events and festivals.
- Maintain existing processes and develop new processes as needed to maintain maximum efficiency.
- Maintain inventory of festival assets, including ensuring dirty, dusty and grimy gear returned from festivals is kept in top shape, organized and cared for.  Assess loss after each festival and coordinate with Operations and Client Account Managers for coverage of damage from client.
- Provide support and training on FGTs products and services at events and festivals.
- Execute other duties, projects and events as assigned.
